conclusions: Guard initialization/readback is outside the timed kernel interval; the policy changes DDR allocation offsets and sizes.
Paired profile preserves CT/NE/TDMA activity while Tile 0 RDMA is about 0.229 ms longer with guards. It does not establish the DDR bank mapping or permit additive Primary attribution.
Disabling fixed arguments leaves Instr and target LLVM byte-identical and does not improve measured ordinary GEMM: production 7.024 ms median vs control 7.117 ms; all six output files byte-identical.
The remaining roughly 2.5–3.5% gap against historical ordinary medians is unresolved. Historical and current boots differ; no cross-boot hardware/cache/frequency cause has been established.
No production optimization change is retained from these diagnostic experiments.
